about.title: About Ark Fence Company
text: A faith-based, family-owned fence company serving North Houston with honesty and integrity.

Ark Fence Company was founded in 2019 with a simple mission: to bring honest, high-quality fencing to North Houston homeowners and businesses. As a faith-based, family-owned company, we believe in doing the job right the first time and treating every customer the way we'd want to be treated.

From our home base in Magnolia, we've grown by word of mouth — earning 133+ five-star reviews from customers who mention our reasonable pricing, fast turnaround, clean work, and excellent communication. We use better materials, beat competing bids, and keep you updated from the first estimate to the final walkthrough.
